content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Infrastructure Works
summary: A private residential development in Rouiba comprising four detached villas, delivered under a comprehensive all-trades package (TCE) including roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project integrates structural engineering, modern facade articulation, and dedicated utility connections to establish a self-contained residential enclave.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete construction cycle for this residential development. The scope of work encompassed reinforced-concrete structural framing, masonry, interior and exterior finishes, MEP installations, and dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD) to ensure independent utility routing and vehicle access.

The architectural design features clean geometric massing, recessed glazing, and integrated pergolas. Site planning prioritised optimal circulation, private boundary definition, and seamless integration with the surrounding urban fabric of Rouiba.
content.authority: This development demonstrates our capacity to deliver high-density, low-rise residential schemes, coordinating structural execution, architectural finishes, and civil works under a single contract.

faq.question: What was the construction scope for the Rouiba villa project?
faq.answer: The project was delivered under a complete all-trades package (TCE), covering everything from reinforced-concrete structural works to interior finishes and external civil works.

faq.question: How were the infrastructure and utility connections managed?
faq.answer: The contract included dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD), establishing independent water, electricity, and drainage connections alongside paved vehicle and pedestrian access.

faq.question: What are the key architectural features of these villas?
faq.answer: The villas feature contemporary geometric massing, flat-roof profiles, recessed window openings to manage solar gain, and integrated structural pergolas.
